title: Beam Model Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2611.26358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization,

translated_abstract: Beam 是一个稀疏混合专家模型，总参数量为 5013 亿，活跃参数量为 234 亿，专为编程、推理和智能体工作负载而构建和优化。Beam 能够提供前沿水平的推理能力，同时其所需推理计算量比同级别的许多模型少 3-4 倍。Beam 在 23.8 万亿个多样化、经过精选的高质量 token 上进行预训练，并通过一种新颖的两阶段中期训练方法实现了 100 万 token 的上下文窗口，该阶段建立在可验证的、以正确性为锚点的数据之上。后训练阶段利用大规模、完全异步的强化学习（RL）训练，在 10500 块 GB300 GPU 上进行，在 4 周的训练中生成了超过 1 亿次 rollout。我们相信这是迄今为止任何开放实验室所进行的最大规模强化学习训练之一。在评估套件中，随着强化学习计算量的增加，模型能力持续提升，未出现平台期的迹象。在深度硬件-模型协同设计的支持下，Beam 采用了 FP8/NVFP4 量化技术。
tldr: Beam 是一个总参数 5013 亿、活跃参数 234 亿的稀疏 MoE 模型，专为编程、推理和智能体任务优化，通过 23.8 万亿 token 预训练、两阶段中期训练实现百万 token 上下文窗口，并在 10500 块 GB300 GPU 上开展开放实验室中最大规模的强化学习后训练，以比同类模型少 3-4 倍的推理计算量达到前沿推理水平。
en_tdlr: Beam is a sparse MoE model with 501.3B total and 23.4B active parameters, optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads, achieving frontier-level reasoning with 3-4x less inference compute through 23.8T-token pretraining, a novel two-stage midtraining for a 1M-token context window, and one of the largest-scale RL post-training runs (10.5K GB300 GPUs, 100M+ rollouts) conducted by an open lab.
